entries.source: #LIGHT_BLUE#You notice an entrance to an underwater cave.
entries.target: #LIGHT_BLUE#你发现了一个水下洞穴的入口。
联合王国半身人巡逻队

entries.source: You have got nothing to fear if you are not using filthy arcane magic. Otherwise: DIE!
entries.target: 如果你没有使用肮脏的魔法，那不用害怕他们。否则的话：去死吧！

entries.source: You find a hidden trap door, and hear cries for help from within...
entries.target: 你发现了一个隐藏的活板门，并听到从里面传来呼救声……

entries.source: #LIGHT_BLUE#You carefully get away without making a sound.
#LIGHT_RED#You carefully open the trap door and enter the underground tunnels...
entries.target: #LIGHT_RED#你小心打开地板上的活门进入了地下通道……

entries.source: #LIGHT_RED#As you enter you notice the trap door has no visible handle on the inside. You are stuck here!
entries.target: #LIGHT_RED#进入地道后，你发现活门内侧看不到任何把手，你被关在这里了！

entries.source:
You find an entrance to an old crypt. An aura of terrible evil emanates from this place. You feel threatened just standing there.
You hear the muffled cries of a woman coming from inside.
entries.target:
你发现了一个古老地宫的入口，里面笼罩着恐怖的邪恶气息，仅仅站在门口你就已经感受到了它的威胁。
你听到里面隐约传来一个女人沉闷的哭喊声。

entries.source: #LIGHT_RED#You carefully open the door and enter the underground crypt...
entries.target: #LIGHT_RED#你小心翼翼地打开门，进入了地下的地宫……

entries.source: #LIGHT_RED#As you enter you notice the door has no visible handle on the inside. You are stuck here!
entries.target: #LIGHT_RED#当你进入后，你发现这扇门的里侧没有门把，你被困在这了！

entries.source: Entrance to some ancient elven ruins

Only crumbling bones are left of what once was the proud Director Hompalan, chief of this facility.
Now those remains look at you with empty eyes but you can not mistake their intent.
entries.target:
这个研究设施的主人，曾经如此高傲的研究主管红帕兰，现在已经只剩下摇摇欲坠的枯骨。
尽管这具遗骸只剩下空洞无神的眼窝，但你绝不会弄错它的意图。

entries.source: An elven cultist. He doesn't seem to mind you.
entries.target: 一个精灵邪教徒。他似乎并不在意你。

entries.source: Something the cultists are doing is coming. Beware.
entries.target: 邪教徒正在进行的某件事即将发生。小心。

entries.source: The cultist's soul seems to be absorbed by the strange stone he was guarding. You feel like something is about to happen...
entries.target: 邪教徒的灵魂似乎被其守卫的奇异石头所吸收。你感觉似乎要出大事了……

entries.source: This demon would be very attractive if not for the hovering crown of flames, the three tails and sharp claws. As you watch her you can almost feel pain digging in your flesh. She wants you to suffer.
entries.target: 要不是她头上盘旋的火焰王冠、三条尾巴和锋利的爪子，这只恶魔本会非常迷人。当你看着她时，你几乎能感觉到痛苦正钻进你的血肉。她想让你受苦。

entries.source: and used for her perverted desires
entries.target: 并将其用于满足她的变态欲望

entries.source: This crown of pure flames possesses a myriad of small molten rocks floating wildly above it. Each can be removed to throw as a true meteor.
entries.target: 这顶由纯粹火焰所打造的王冠上漂浮着许多小小的熔融石块，每个都可以用意念扔出，化作一块真实的陨石砸向大地。

entries.source:
A terrible shout thunders across the level: 'Come my darling, come, I will be ssssooo *nice* to you!'
You should flee from this level!
entries.target:
一个恐怖的声音突然自空中传来：“来吧，亲爱的，来吧，我会好好地‘疼’你的。”
你必须逃离此地！

entries.source: %s pulls a dagger and opens his own chest, piercing his beating heart. The stone glows with malevolent colors.
entries.target: %s拔出一把匕首，剖开自己的胸膛，刺穿了跳动的心脏。石头泛起了邪恶的光芒。
